buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses MINIMUM QUALIFYING CRITERIA (MQC):(Tenderers should have to uploaded below MQC documents (scanned copies) on online mode only) Tenderers must fulfill all the following qualifying criteria to be considered eligible for opening of their Price- Bids and for award of Work. i) Financial Standing: - Tenderer shall have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 20,81,493/- for last three years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25. ii) Experience: - The Tenderer must have successfully completed Annual Maintenance Contract work of Fire Tenders during last seven years ending last day of month previous to the one in which this Tender is invite d as either of the following: a) Three similar completed works costing not less than the amount equal to 40% of the estimated cost amo unting to Rs. 32,74,883/- OR b) Two similar completed works costing not less than the amount equal to 50% of the estimated cost amou nting to Rs. 40,93,603/- OR c) One similar completed work costing not less than the amount equal to 80% of the estimated cost amoun ting to Rs. 65,49,766/- “Similar work” means “Annual Maintenance Contract work of Fire Tenders” Tenderer shall produce documentary evidence for the satisfactory completion of these works. 2. ELIGIBILITY AND QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:- Tenderer shall also meet the following requirements. (Scanned copies of the documents shall be uploaded on GeM Portal) a) The Tenderer shall have a full-fledged workshop to repair heavy motor vehicles in Mumbai or Navi Mum bai area. Details of Workshop equipment shall be provided on company’s letterhead. b) Tenderer to have GST Registration Number, PAN Card. Details shall be submitted. c) Information regarding any current litigation in which the tenderer is involved. d) Tenderer debarred or blacklisted from any Government / Semi-Government / Public Sector Units will be rejected at any time and at any stage. Tenderers have to submit the declaration on their company’s Letter head while submitting the Tender. e) Notwithstanding anything stated above, JNPA reserves the right to assess the Tenderer's capability and capacity to perform the contract. The Tenderer shall submit the following along with the Tender: a) The bidder shall fill the Bid Security Declaration as per the enclosed Form XIII of the tender document. T he scan copies of same shall be uploaded along-with the Technical Bid. In addition to the Bid Security Decl

aration, the bidder shall upload the scan copies of SSI/NSIC or MSME, if the firm is registered under SSI/NSI C or MSME provided valid certificate from such registering authority is submitted. b) Annual turnovers duly certified by a qualified Chartered Accountant for last three financial years. (2022- 23, 2023-24, 2024-25). Reports on the financial standing of Tenderer including audited profit and loss state ments for last three years duly certified by the Charted Accountant, balance sheets and P&L statement for the last three financial years. The financial turnover in the last Three years should be indicated as per For m-III of this Tender. These details will be used for evaluating average annual turnover. Important Instructions :- 1.Bids submitted from the same IP address will not be considered for evaluation. 2. Detailed Price breakup will be required to upload along with the financial bid. .
